about: AN EXAMPLE, not a deployment: production.json with mainnet offered beside chipnet. Mainnet is enabled only to meet the requirements of BCH Blaze; nothing here has been audited; coins can be lost; this project does not recommend enabling it. A new visitor starts on "network"; the network label in the header of the wallet and of the recoverer's page lets a person choose the other. Without "mainnetEnabled": true, mainnet is not offered and the pages show no choice. Each network may name its own backup stores; one store can keep archives of both.
